pure-announcement.rationale: It is a practice essay on curating agent context, not a launch — product mentions serve as worked examples of the techniques.

duplicate.rationale: None of the supplied nearest concepts covers context engineering as a discipline — the closest, retrieval-as-composition and code-mode, treat narrower retrieval mechanics, and the corpus's context-layer note is data infrastructure, not token curation.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Core claims cite checkable sources — context-rot benchmarking, the transformer attention paper, position-interpolation work — and describe reproducible techniques.

durability.rationale: Attention as a finite budget with n-squared pairwise cost, right-altitude prompting, just-in-time retrieval, compaction, note-taking and sub-agent isolation are mechanisms and trade-offs that will hold regardless of which model generation runs them.

actionability.rationale: It prescribes directly usable practice: minimal high-signal prompts tested before adding rules, non-overlapping tool sets, canonical few-shot examples over edge-case lists, and recall-first-then-precision tuning for compaction.

atomicity.rationale: Everything serves one stateable principle — treat context as a scarce resource and curate the smallest high-signal token set — with the long-horizon techniques as instances of it, not separate ideas.
